title: Envelope
description: What a client posts to /v1/batches. HPKE (RFC 9180) base mode, so that TLS-terminating proxies, CDNs and access logs never see a batch in the clear. info is the batch schema id; the key id is passed as additional authenticated data.

key_id.description: Which ingest key encrypted this envelope, for example 2026q4. Keys rotate quarterly and the previous key is accepted for 30 more days.

enc.description: Encapsulated key, 32 bytes, base64url without padding.
